## Overview

<!-- TODO: 2–3 sentences on what VIGAT does and why a window is better than the whole gene body / promoter. -->

## Setup

```{r}
library(VIGAT)
library(Seurat)
library(Signac)

Sys.setenv(OPENAI_API_KEY = "your_openai_API_key")
```

## Example data

<!-- TODO: describe the islet sample (GSM7618328_GSM7618327) and where to download it. -->

```{r}
obj <- readRDS("islet_example.rds")
DefaultAssay(obj) <- "ATAC"
Idents(obj) <- "ATAC_snn_res.0.8"   # TODO: your ATAC clustering column
table(Idents(obj))
```

## Choose marker genes

```{r}
marker_genes <- c("INS", "GCG", "SST", "PPY", "PRSS1", "KRT19")  # TODO
```

## Run VIGAT

```{r}
res <- run_vigat(
  obj     = obj,
  genes   = marker_genes,
  tissue  = "Islet",
  species = "human",
  outdir  = "VIGAT_output/islet"
)
```

## Selected windows

```{r}
res$vigat_window_df
```

## Use the count matrix

```{r}
obj[["VIGAT"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = res$count_matrix)
DefaultAssay(obj) <- "VIGAT"
obj <- NormalizeData(obj)
FeaturePlot(obj, features = marker_genes, reduction = "umap")
```
